bull.name: Green Fist
bull.tell: Close above open. Buyers finished on top.
bull.counter: Don't fade a clean push. Wait for a lower low.
bull.origin: Walks in more than anyone. The default print. Body up, buyers won the period.
bull.invalidation: A lower low after the push. Until then, fading is a hobby.
bull.anatomy: Body runs up from the open. Upper wick is leftover offer. Lower wick is a dip that got bought.
bull.when: Inside an uptrend it is continuation. After a hammer it can be confirmation. Alone it is just one period.
bull.trap: Chasing a huge green body into resistance. The move already paid someone else.
bull.classroom: Candles are a print, not a prophecy. Write a number after the close, not during the wick.

hammer.name: Anvil
hammer.tell: Long lower wick. Buyers shoved a dump back.
hammer.counter: Don't short the rejection. Look for a bounce.
hammer.origin: Shows up after the floor got tested. Long lower wick, small body on top. Location first.
hammer.invalidation: A close back through the low of the wick. That low is the idea. Lose it, flatten.
hammer.anatomy: Lower wick should dwarf the body. Close near the high. Location matters more than the drawing.
hammer.when: After a selloff, sitting on support. In the middle of nowhere it is just a shape.
hammer.trap: Buying every hammer. Most of them are noise. Confirm on the next close.
hammer.classroom: Invalidation lives under the wick. Close back through that low, the idea is dead.

engulf-bull.name: The Swallow
engulf-bull.tell: A green body ate the last red one whole.
engulf-bull.counter: Momentum flipped up. Don't stay short.
engulf-bull.origin: Two-candle fighter. New green body covers the last red body. Context decides if it is a flip or a pause.
engulf-bull.invalidation: A new lower low after the swallow. One greedy body in a waterfall is not a vote.
engulf-bull.anatomy: New open at or under the last close. New close above the last open.
engulf-bull.when: At a floor after a selloff. One engulfing in a strong downtrend can just be a pause.
engulf-bull.trap: Calling a flip in the middle of a waterfall because one body was greedy.
engulf-bull.classroom: Confluence: one fighter is not a vote. The desk wants more than one seat.

marubozu.name: Clean Cut
marubozu.tell: Almost no wicks. One side owned the whole period.
marubozu.counter: Respect the pressure. Don't chase the close.
marubozu.origin: No leftover fight. Open near one extreme, close near the other. The move already paid someone else.
marubozu.invalidation: Chasing the close. The next wick is often your entry — and your regret.
marubozu.anatomy: Open near one extreme, close near the other. Almost no leftover wick.
marubozu.when: When one side owned the whole period. Pressure, not a chase.
marubozu.trap: Market-ordering the close of a marubozu. You paid the winner.
marubozu.classroom: Size first. Direction second. A clean cut already paid someone else.

bear.name: Red Fade
bear.tell: Close below open. Sellers finished on top.
bear.counter: Don't catch the knife. Wait for a higher high.
bear.origin: Mirror of the Fist. Body down, sellers won the period. One red is not a collapse.
bear.invalidation: A higher high after the fade. Knives keep falling until that prints.
bear.anatomy: Body runs down from the open.
bear.when: Inside a downtrend it is continuation.
bear.trap: Catching the knife because it already dropped.

doji.name: The Tie
doji.tell: Tiny body. A draw. Nobody won the period.
doji.counter: Stand still. Wait for the next candle.
doji.origin: The period that refused to pick a side.
doji.invalidation: The next close. A tie is not a thesis.
doji.when: After a long run it is a pause.
doji.trap: Treating a doji as reversal gospel.

star.name: Sky Kick
star.tell: Long upper wick. Sellers shoved a pump back.
star.counter: Don't chase the wick. Look for a drop.
star.origin: Shows up after the ceiling got tested.
star.invalidation: A close back through the high of the wick.
star.trap: Shorting the wick while buyers are still fighting.
star.classroom: FOMO is a market order into someone else's exit.

engulf-bear.name: The Crush
engulf-bear.tell: A red body ate the last green one whole.
engulf-bear.counter: Momentum flipped down. Don't stay long.
engulf-bear.origin: Two-candle fighter. New red body covers the last green body.
engulf-bear.invalidation: A new higher high after the crush.
engulf-bear.anatomy: New red body covers last green body.
engulf-bear.when: After a rip, at a ceiling.
engulf-bear.trap: Flipping the whole bias on one candle.
engulf-bear.classroom: Trends take more than one crush to die.

spin.name: The Feint
spin.tell: Big wicks, tiny body. A fight with no winner.
spin.counter: Not a signal. Wait for the next close.
spin.invalidation: Treating indecision as a secret signal.
spin.anatomy: Range is large, body is a stub.
spin.when: In a trend it's a rest. At a level it's a warning.
spin.classroom: If the chart needs a paragraph, it is not a setup.

wick.name: WICK
wick.tell: ETH structure only. Body, wick, close. Never answers BTC.
wick.counter: Don't lock. Vote. Vitalik speaks last.
wick.origin: Dedicated ETH specialist. Same slang as the Dojo. Separate memory from BTC WICK.
wick.invalidation: Answering Bitcoin. Pattern specialists never answer the other coin.
wick.anatomy: 45-bar ETH structure, mean-rev and extension fade.
wick.when: Every ETH 1H window. Structure first, then the close.
wick.trap: Copying BTC WICK. This is not a clone.
wick.classroom: Candles are a print, not a prophecy. Write the number after the close.

pulse.name: PULSE
pulse.tell: Who is actually trading this window. Quiet tape is not a vote.
pulse.counter: Don't size a dead book. Wait for flow.
pulse.origin: ETH relative strength lives in the tape, not the story.
pulse.invalidation: Volume that is all one side of a 99¢ chalk book.
pulse.anatomy: Flow vs the last print. Pulse first, direction second.
pulse.when: When ETH is moving vs BTC, or when it isn't.
pulse.classroom: A window with no flow is a WAIT. Permission to sit.

vel.name: VEL
vel.tell: CEX velocity versus the contract. Lag is a tell, not a chase.
vel.counter: Don't fade the lag if the book is already chalk.
vel.origin: Spot prints first. Kalshi catches up. VEL names the gap.
vel.invalidation: No spot feed. If you cannot name the lag, you sit.
vel.anatomy: Spot speed versus the ETH hour book.
vel.when: When ETH spot is running and the contract hasn't moved.
vel.trap: Chasing a gap that already closed.
vel.classroom: Name the settlement source before you name the direction.

cheap.name: CHEAP
cheap.tell: The recovery side. Soft ask after a shove. Not a hero fade.
cheap.counter: Don't catch the knife. Cheap is value after the close agrees.
cheap.origin: ETH windows mean-revert more than BTC 15m. Cheap sits on the soft side.
cheap.invalidation: A new extension through the cheap side. Value died.
cheap.anatomy: Soft side of the hour after a shove.
cheap.when: After a wick, not during it.
cheap.trap: Buying every dip because ETH 'always comes back.'
cheap.classroom: Size from the stop, not the vibe. Cheap is a price, not a feeling.
